set(RABITQ_SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/RaBitQ-Library-0.7.0)

add_library(rabitqlib INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(rabitqlib SYSTEM INTERFACE "${RABITQ_SOURCE_DIR}/include")

if(RABITQ_SUPPORTED)
  set(RABITQ_BUILD_INDEX OFF)
  set(RABITQ_BUILD_FASTSCAN ON)
  set(RABITQ_BUILD_SAMPLES OFF)
  set(RABITQ_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
  set(RABITQ_BUILD_PYTHON_BINDINGS OFF)
  set(RABITQ_USE_OPENMP OFF)
  set(RABITQ_ENABLE_NATIVE_OPTIMIZATION OFF)
  add_subdirectory("${RABITQ_SOURCE_DIR}" rabitq SYSTEM)
  target_link_libraries(rabitqlib INTERFACE rabitqlib::fastscan)
endif()
